title: Research the first How We Know lineage case
objective: Select, source, review, and propose one real public How We Know dossier in which multiple apparent mentions can be compared with their underlying independent evidence lineages, preserving contrary findings and reporting a negative result if no candidate satisfies the admission bar.
required_evaluation: primary or authoritative source identity and edition review
exact source-span verification by an independently rooted reviewer
license, quotation, snapshot, and disclosure review
lineage and dependence review including unknown relationships
reproduction of every public count and displayed relation from accepted dossier objects
acceptance: the selected case is about truth, evidence, knowledge, or information rather than Epistemedia itself
the case includes a useful human question and at least one material dependence, contradiction, qualification, or unresolved defeater
every public factual statement maps to an exact accepted source span or is labeled as interpretation, hypothesis, or open question
source editions, retrieval dates, custody, digests, locators, and licensing limitations are recorded
raw mention and independent-lineage counts are derivable rather than editorially typed claims
copied or shared upstream material does not receive independent evidential credit
negative candidate searches and excluded cases are retained with reasons
the work does not claim a universal resolution of a philosophical position
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: One case is an instrumented vertical slice, not evidence of general corpus quality or user comprehension.
Source availability or copyright may require public metadata and digests while restricting stored bytes.
Model-generated extraction is candidate evidence and receives no authority without source-span review.
